nodes.title: 1 | PLATE
widgets_values:
**Any shot length.** `TOTAL FRAMES` must be **77** (one Animate chunk) or **149** (two chunks, unmute block 7b).
The plate is hold-padded on its last frame so a short clip never starves chunk 2, then trimmed back to the real frame count at delivery.

The plate is resampled to **delivery res (1920x1080)** BEFORE tracking, so the generated face keeps its resolution advantage in the comp (v1 composited at 1284x716 and upscaled the finished comp, which threw the detail away). For a real 4K plate set 8a/1c to the plate's own size (no resample).

Top/bottom pad = 64 px each so the tracked crop can never clip the frame edge. Un-pad happens in block 9.

nodes.title: ● PER-SHOT | 1c'' | EXPRESSION from a separate clip (5h0) instead of the plate
● PER-SHOT | 1c3 | FULL QUALITY (0 = 6-step iterate, 1 = official 20-step, ~3x slower)
1c | ORIGINAL frame count (delivery trims to this)
1e | hold last frame (safety pad for later chunks)
● PER-SHOT | 1h | plate -> delivery res (crop=center, no stretch)
● PER-SHOT | 1j | EXTRA PAD (px margin on each side, added to the preflight's measured per-side minimum; memory grows with pad)
2 | TRACK
widgets_values:
**SAM 3.1 text tracking, no click.** `head:1` = track one head. SAM3 detects by text every 4 frames and propagates with memory in between, so it re-acquires the head after it leaves frame or turns away (a SAM2 click could not). Runs on the 1024-wide copy like SAM2 did; mask scaled back up in 2f.

If it grabs the wrong thing, tighten the prompt ("man's head:1") or raise `detection_threshold`. The QC overlay shows what was tracked. Fallback with the SAM2 click: the `_click` build.

nodes.title: 2b | SAM 3.1 checkpoint (carries its own text encoder)
2d | track the head through every frame (1024 space)
● PER-SHOT | 2c0 | CLICK FRAME (-1 = auto: the preflight's best-face frame; else a frame number where the face is visible)
2c1 | click frame = a if a >= 0 else best-face frame b
● PER-SHOT | 2d2 | FACE PICKER (mode: id_photo auto / click 2d1 / index from overlay)
QC | tracked heads overlay (the NUMBER on each head = index for the picker's index mode)
● PER-SHOT | 2g | OCCLUDER to track (SAM3 text, one concept: hand / microphone / phone ...)
2h | track occluders (1024 space, up to 4 objects)
2f | tracked head mask -> padded plate size
2f' | tracker never empty: a frame with no head reuses the nearest tracked frame (crop safety; the hole stays empty there)
QC | held frames (head out of frame / lost)
3 | MATTE
widgets_values:
Face-only replacement (decision 2026-09-05): the plate keeps its OWN hair, ears, neck and wardrobe.
`FaceSegment` (face parsing) with skin + eyes + brows + nose + mouth + lips + eyeglasses ON and **Neck OFF** -> x SAM2 head -> CORE (hard) and FEATHER (soft, temporally smoothed) mattes.
Why FaceSegment and not ClothesSegment: ClothesSegment's "Face" label INCLUDES the neck (measured: the matte ran ~100 px below the chin), which let the reference's collar and necklace through onto the plate's t-shirt. FaceSegment has a separate Neck class.

**Two mattes, on purpose.** The FACE matte (3c/3e) goes EMPTY when the actor turns past profile (this plate: frames ~106-149 are profile-to-back), and KJ `BatchCropFromMaskAdvanced` crashes on an empty mask (`stack expects each tensor to be equal size`). So the CROPS are tracked by the TRACK matte (3c''/3d/3d' = face matte + a 70 px-eroded SAM2 head blob, never empty), while the generation HOLE and the COMPOSITE use the FACE matte cropped with the same boxes (4a'/4a''/4a'''). Frames with no visible face therefore get an empty hole and an empty comp alpha: the plate passes through untouched instead of a face being painted on the back of a head.

nodes.title: 3b | close gaps in the face mask
● PER-FACE | 3a'' | HEAD SIZE: erode the hair 0 px (bigger = smaller head; 0 = plate hair silhouette)
3a''' | face region + eroded hair (= HEAD region)
3a-sw | HEAD MODE ? face+hair region : face region
3c | SAM2 head  x  face region  (= FACE matte, may be EMPTY at profile/back)
3c-sw | WIDE SHOT ? SAM3 head : face matte
3c-occ | FACE matte minus occluders (hole + alpha never cover a hand in front of the face)
3c' | SAM2 head eroded 70 px = head-centre blob (tracking fallback, never composited)
3c'' | face matte + head blob  (= TRACK matte, never empty)
3c-sw' | WIDE SHOT ? SAM3 head : face + head blob (tracker)
3d | TRACK core (hard) - drives the face-driver crop 4b
3d' | TRACK feather (temporal smooth) - drives the context crop 4a
3d'' | crop tracker: hard 0.5 (kills the temporal trail that inflated the crop 3x on a moving head)
3d3 | crop tracker never empty (a tiny head erased by feather+threshold reuses the last box)
3e | FACE feather matte (soft + temporal smooth) - the HOLE and the COMP
4 | TRACKED CROP
widgets_values:
Two crops from the same tracked matte:

**4a** context crop (`crop_size_mult 1.8`) - what Animate regenerates and what is composited back.
**4b** face-driver crop (`1.3`, matches Wan-Animate's own preprocess `get_face_bboxes(scale=1.3)` -> 512x512) - drives EXPRESSION only, never composited.

KJ `batchcrop_nodes.py` carries the local patch (see memory `kjnodes-batchcrop-patch`); if the crop comes out ~4x too small the pack was updated and reverted it. DBG frame in 4c should show the face filling ~55% of the box.

nodes.title: 4a | CONTEXT crop (mult 1.8) - tracked by the TRACK matte
4b | FACE-DRIVER crop (mult 1.05 = official face-keypoint framing, face fills ~80%)
4a'' | crop the FACE matte with 4a's boxes (same masks input => same bboxes)
4e0 | cropped head never empty (WIDE driver crop safety)
4e'' | x cropped head (keeps the parse inside the tracked head)
4e''' | WIDE face-driver crop from the CROP (mult 1.05, tracked by the cropped head)
4e-sw | WIDE SHOT ? crop parse : plate matte (hole + alpha)
4e-sw' | WIDE SHOT ? crop driver : plate driver
DBG | is the crop framed right?
5 | ANIMATE INPUTS
widgets_values:
Wan2.2 Animate **replacement mode**, exactly as its own preprocess builds it:
- **background_video** = the context crop with the face region painted BLACK (Wan preprocess: `frame * (1 - mask)`).
- **character_mask** = that region, grown and **blockified 32 px** (official template) so the model may re-draw a slightly larger area than the composite takes.
- **face_video** = 512x512 face crops from the PLATE -> expression, blinks, mouth come from the actor's performance.
- **reference_image** = the target identity head shot (also CLIP-Vision encoded). Head-and-shoulders crop, square-ish, NO full body.
- no pose_video: face-only, body pose is irrelevant (input is optional in the node).

`RENDER` = 768: the context crop is upscaled to 768x768 before generation, so the face is rendered at ~426 px instead of the plate's 258 px. This is THE resolution lever. Drop to 640 on OOM.

nodes.title: 5e | grow the hole (8 px @ RENDER - tight: the head is pinned to the plate silhouette; 24 px made the head 30% too big)
5f | blockify 16 (official template uses 32 for a whole body)
● PER-SHOT | 5h0 | EXPRESSION DRIVER clip (a performance of the expressions you want; any framing)
5h-sw | EXPRESSION clip ? clip driver : plate driver
5i0 | PREFLIGHT: full-clip face scan; stops on bad inputs; best face -> picker
QC | preflight report (plate/reference face px, head-width ratio, suggested RENDER + PAD)
QC | auto WHO to replace = best face found in the clip (feeds the face picker)
5i2 | grow so the crop keeps some shoulder
5i3 | square head crop of the reference (mult 1.5)
QC | reference head as the model sees it
● PER-FACE | 5m2 | HEAD WIDTH: nose/eye/ear points x1 about the nose (1.0 = plate head width, 1.15 = +19%; rotation kept)
5n | pose_video: body + head links, NO face points (Animate training format)
6 | MODEL
widgets_values:
LoRA stack order matters little, strengths do:
- **lightx2v I2V distill 1.0** -> 6 steps / cfg 1 / shift 8 (iterate mode, ComfyUI template values). **FULL mode** (builder flag `full`, files `*_full`): distill BYPASSED, **20 steps, shift 5.0, cfg 1.0 = the official Wan-Animate inference config** (`wan_animate_14B.py`). CFG stays 1 in both: the paper disables classifier-free guidance by default, so the negative prompt is inert either way.
- **relight LoRA** (BYPASSED until downloaded: `WanAnimate_relight_lora_fp16.safetensors`) - matches the inserted face's lighting/colour to the plate. Un-bypass after download.
- **IDENTITY LoRA** `akash_test_v1_low_noise.safetensors` @0.7 - trained on Wan2.2 T2V; Animate shares the 40-block DiT so the low-noise expert key-matches. Watch the log for `lora key not loaded` on first run. Raise toward 0.9 if likeness is weak, lower if skin goes waxy.
- **RealismBoost 0.4 ON** and identity LoRA = the 2000-step save @0.8: the user's A/B on 2026-09-05 showed clearly better pores and beard with no waxiness; bypass 6e to compare.
- ModelSamplingSD3 shift 8 (official template).

widgets_values:
`WanAnimateToVideo` builds the conditioning: reference latent + masked background + face driver.
`trim_latent` / `trim_image` strip the reference frame from the decoded batch (official template wiring).

Steps 6 / cfg 1 / euler / simple with the distill LoRA. Seed FIXED so chunk 2 and re-runs are reproducible.

nodes.title: 7a | GENERATE every chunk in one node (TOTAL FRAMES -> 77 + 72 x (N-1) frames, 5-frame overlap)
8 | INTEGRATE
widgets_values:
**8a** grades the generated crop to the plate crop (`mkl` 0.7, v1 measured value).

**8b-8k SeedVR2 detail pass - MUTED until the model is downloaded.** SeedVR2 is a one-step diffusion *video* restorer: it synthesises pores and micro-texture consistently across frames (per-frame GFPGAN/CodeFormer flicker). The generated crop goes up 2x, is restored, then comes back down to crop res, so the composite receives supersampled detail.
Enable: unmute the group, then drag **8k** output into **9a `cropped_images`** (replacing 8l).
Needs: `seedvr2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors` (diffusion_models) + `seedvr2_ema_vae_fp16.safetensors` (vae).

nodes.title: ● PER-SHOT | 8a | grade generated -> plate crop (mkl 0.85: pulls the reference's shine/tone toward the plate's matte skin)
8k | back to crop res  -> CONNECT TO 9a WHEN ENABLED
8l | back to tracked-crop res (locked to crop)  [unused: SeedVR2 path 8k feeds 9a]
8r | DETAIL MIX: 0 = colour-matched crop only, 1 = full SeedVR2 (0.5 tames the oily / over-sharpened look)
● PER-SHOT | 8s | PLATE MATCH softness = 0.7 px Gaussian (core ImageBlur sigma is a FRACTION of radius: radius 7 x 0.1 = 0.7 px; 0.9 here would be 6 px!)
8t | MOTION-BLUR MATCH (180-degree shutter; no-op below 2 px/frame)
8n | close gaps in the generated parse
8o | plate face matte + generated face parse
8o' | minus occluders (the real hand stays on top of the new face)
8q | comp alpha -> image (for the matte delivery)
9 | COMPOSITE
widgets_values:
**9a** = the finished comp (plate + face through the FEATHER matte).
`border_blending` MUST stay 0: the node blurs the alpha by (crop/2 x blending)/4 - at 0.25 on a 784 px crop that is a 25 px box + 25 px gaussian, which ballooned the face matte over the hair and collar (first v2 run). The FEATHER matte already carries its own 15 px blur.
**9c** = the same uncrop over a BLACK canvas -> a **premultiplied face ELEMENT** with the matte as its alpha. Nuke: `Merge(over)` element onto plate using matte.exr, or `Copy` matte into alpha and Premult - no need to re-derive anything.
**9e** trims back to the ORIGINAL frame count (block 1c) so the hold-pad frames never reach delivery.

nodes.title: 9f | comp alpha -> plate-res matte (square paste of the alpha image)
10 | DELIVER (VFX grade)
widgets_values:
Four LINEAR float EXR sequences, frame 1001+, all at delivery res and the same frame count, written to
`output/vfx_exr/v2/<YYYY-MM-DD_hh-mm-ss>/<element>_v001/<element>_v001.1001.exr` - **every run gets its own date-time folder**, one stamp shared by all four writers (SaveEXR local patch; the frontend only expands `%date%` for the core SaveImage node). If a version somehow exists already, the writer moves to the next free one and says so in the log instead of failing.
- `comp`    finished composite (reference only)
- `element` premultiplied face over black (the thing you comp)
- `matte`   feather matte (alpha for the element)
- `plate`   the resampled plate the comp was built against (comp = plate + element via matte, exactly)

**Bump `version` on all four SaveEXR nodes for every delivery** - the node refuses to overwrite an existing frame (it raises "File exists already"), which is the guard against mixing two runs in one sequence. The prefix is ABSOLUTE on purpose: a relative prefix makes the node fall back to ComfyUI's running counter and drop every run into one folder.

`SaveEXR.tonemap` describes the INPUT: `sRGB` converts to linear = CORRECT. `linear` would write sRGB numbers into a linear file.
Plus sRGB h264 review + QC matte mp4. Grain: the generated face is grain-free; regrain in Nuke from the plate (or `Image Film Grain` if a quick review needs it).

READ ME - FACE REPLACE v8 (Wan2.2 Animate engine)
widgets_values:
# FACE REPLACE v8 - Wan2.2 Animate replacement engine

## v8 (2026-09-08): CONTROL PANEL
- **Tracker never empty** (2f'): on frames where SAM3 finds no head (head out of frame, tracker dropout) the previous tracked mask is held so the crop boxes never collapse; the hole and alpha still come from the face parse, so nothing is painted there. The QC box lists the held frames.
- Group **0 | CONTROL PANEL** at the far left holds every black node. Column 1 = the shot (plate clip, TOTAL FRAMES, the four switches, extra pad, render size, tracking text, occluder text, delivery version). Column 2 = the face (reference photo, identity LoRA, RealismBoost, prompt, HEAD WIDTH, hair erode, expression clip). Column 3 = the picker (mode, index, stop_after_pick, CLICK FRAME, click editor). The panel is wireless: its values reach the engine through Set/Get pairs, so nothing else in the graph needs touching.

## v7 (2026-09-08): ONE workflow
- Everything that used to be a separate file is now a **black switch in group 1**: `1c HEAD MODE` (regenerate the hair too), `1c' WIDE SHOT` (face under ~200 px: matte and driver from the tracked crop), `1c'' EXPRESSION from a separate clip` (5h0), `1c3 FULL QUALITY` (0 = 6-step iterate, 1 = the official 20-step config). The unselected branch of each switch is not executed (lazy inputs).
- **Which face**: node 2d2 `mode` - `id_photo` (automatic: the best face the preflight finds), `click` (set `stop_after_pick` ON, run once for ~1 minute, click the head shown in 2d1, set it OFF, run), `index` (the number drawn on each head in the tracked-heads overlay), `largest`, `leftmost`, `rightmost`.
- **How long**: black node 1b TOTAL FRAMES; the chunk loop (7a) renders 77 + 72 x (N-1) frames and trims to TOTAL. 149 is comfortable, 221 is near the memory ceiling.
- Per face (set once): 5i reference photo, 6d identity LoRA, 6e RealismBoost, 6i prompt, 5m2 HEAD WIDTH. Per shot: 1a plate, 1b frames, the four switches, 2g occluder text, 8s plate softness.
- `_experimental/`: the SCAIL-2 engine (best likeness, head 1.5x too big) and the SAM2 click fallback (no SAM3).

## v6 over v5 (2026-09-07)
- **Second engine: SCAIL-2** (`*_scail_*` builds, ComfyUI core `WanSCAILToVideo`) - EXPERIMENTAL, measured 2026-09-07 on this shot: the best identity of any engine (ArcFace 0.83 vs 0.74) with very good skin, BUT it draws the head ~1.35-1.55x the plate size whatever the mask (head / man), reference framing (1.5-3.0) or crop context (1.8-3.0) - it sizes the head from its own frame prior. Wan2.2 Animate therefore stays the production engine; use the SCAIL builds for identity reference renders or when a plate allows a larger head. Model stack from the official template: SCAIL-2 int8 + DPO LoRA 1.0 + lightx2v 0.8 (+ SCAIL relight LoRA, identity LoRA, RealismBoost), shift 5, 6 steps, cfg 1.
- What SCAIL replaces = what its SAM3 text finds in the RENDER crop (black node 5p, default `head:1`; `human` finds nothing in a head crop - check the QC_scailmask mp4 first). The reference is tracked with the same text so head maps to head.
- The identity LoRA was trained on Wan2.2; SCAIL-2 is Wan2.1. Same architecture, so it loads; check the log for `lora key not loaded` and retrain on Wan2.1 if likeness is weak.
- Chunks chain with `previous_frames` (5-frame overlap, the value SCAIL-2 was trained at); same 77 + 72 x (N-1) frame plan as the Animate builds so the two engines can be compared frame for frame.
- **Preflight** (5i0, local node `FRPreflight`): stops the run with a clear message on a short clip, a tiny plate face, a tiny or missing reference face, and prints the measured face sizes, head-width ratio and suggested RENDER / PAD (the values the black nodes were set from by hand). Drop with the builder flag `nopreflight`.
- **One file per shot type, any length.** TOTAL FRAMES (black node 1b) now drives the whole render: the chunk chain is looped inside one node (7a, local `FRAnimateChunks`: 77-frame chunks, 5-frame overlap, so 77 / 149 / 221 / 293 ... frames). Set 1b to the clip length (or less) and run; the clip is hold-padded to a chunk boundary automatically. Memory: 149 frames at 1080p is comfortable, 221 is near the ceiling on 16 GB / this RAM, longer shots should be split.
'
    '- **Two shot categories.** CLOSE-UP builds (default names) parse the face on the full plate. WIDE builds (`*_wide_*`) parse it on the tracked crop instead, so a face that is a tenth of the frame still gets a full-resolution matte and face driver; the tracker follows the SAM3 head alone. Use WIDE when the face is under ~200 px tall at delivery res (the preflight report prints the size).
'
    '- **Choosing the face.** Node 2d2 mode: `id_photo` (automatic: the best face the preflight finds), `click` (the `*_click` builds: set 2d2 `stop_after_pick` ON and run once - about a minute - so node 2d1 shows the click frame (2c0: auto = the best-face frame, or type a frame number) and the tracked-heads overlay is drawn; click the head; set `stop_after_pick` OFF; run), `index` (type the number shown on each head in the QC tracked-heads overlay), `largest`, `leftmost`, `rightmost`.
'
    '- **Moving heads** (found on the second shot): the crop tracker now thresholds its matte (3d'') so a head travelling across frame no longer inflates the crop with its temporal trail, and the plate is padded PER SIDE by the minimum the preflight measures over every face position plus the black EXTRA PAD margin (1j, 64 px). Memory grows with the padded canvas (a 512 px pad on 149 frames needed 11 GB per uncrop), so sides the head never approaches stay at the margin only.
'
    '- **Face picker** (black node 2d2, local node `FRFacePick`): SAM3 tracks up to 4 heads and the picker names the one to replace - by an ID photo of the actor (default mode `id_photo`; the photo is AUTOMATIC = the largest, most frontal face the preflight finds anywhere in the clip, so a single-person shot needs nothing; for a crowd, build with `FR_PICK_PHOTO=<file>` to get the 2d1 photo node), by size, by index, or by position. ## v5 over v4 (2026-09-07)

## v5 over v4 (2026-09-07)
- **Head size fixed in the `_head` builds** - two black dials: 5m2 HEAD WIDTH (default 1.0 = plate width; 1.15 measured +19%) and 3a'' HEAD SIZE hair erode (default 0). The v3/v4 head hole (grow 24 + blockify 32) let Animate scale the reference head to the box: measured ~30% larger than the plate head, with or without the keypoint retarget. Head builds now use the same tight hole as the face builds (grow 8, blockify 16), and the HAIR part of the hole is eroded (3a'', black, HEAD SIZE): the plate actor's hair is far bigger than the reference's, and Animate sizes the head to the hole, so a hole that covered all of the plate hair gave a head 20-30% too big. ## v4 over v3 (2026-09-07)
- **BLACK nodes = values you must revisit** when the FACE changes (`PER-FACE`) or the SHOT changes (`PER-SHOT`). Everything else is engine convention.
- Layout is packed by measured node height with a gutter for the Get nodes: nothing overlaps.

## v3 over v2 (research pass, 2026-09-05 evening)
- **SAM3 text tracking** (`head:1`) replaces the SAM2 click: no editor, re-acquires the head if it leaves frame. The `_click` builds keep SAM2.
- **Any number of chunks** (77 / 149 / 221 / 293 frames) with the official 5-frame `refert` overlap.
- **FULL mode** = the official inference config (20 steps, shift 5, cfg 1, no distill); iterate mode unchanged.
- Optional **SeedVR2 7B-sharp** detail pass (`seedvr7b` flag).

- Deliveries under `vfx_exr/v3/<date-time>/`.
- **HEAD mode + RETARGET** (`*_head`, flag `retarget`): head keypoints are KEPT for rotation but rescaled to the reference's proportions by the local node `FRHeadRetarget` (custom_nodes/fr_pose_retarget). - **HEAD mode** (`*_head`): hair in both parses, originally a generous 24 px + blockify-32 hole (REMOVED in v5: it scaled the head up ~30%).
- **v3.1 (after the first v3 review: "oily, muscular, eyes differ")**: face-driver crop tightened to the official keypoint framing (4b mult 1.05), DETAIL MIX 0.5 between the colour-matched crop and SeedVR2 (8r), colour match 0.85, identity LoRA 0.7, PLATE MATCH softness (8s, sigma 0.9: the face measured 10x sharper than this 720p plate). ## Deliberately not done
- Multi-reference identity (2-5 refs) exists only in `ComfyUI-WanAnimatePlus` on top of Kijai's WanVideoWrapper, a different engine stack. A v4 candidate if profile likeness must rise.
- MatAnyone2 video matting: built for hair/transparency edges; a face-only skin matte does not need it.

Built 2026-09-05 from research + the official ComfyUI Animate templates. v1 (Bernini-R) stays as-is for A/B.

## Why Animate instead of Bernini
| | v1 Bernini-R | v2 Wan2.2 Animate |
|---|---|---|
| render | fixed 352x640, 73 f | free: 768x768, 77 f per chunk, chainable |
| expression | regenerated from prompt+guide | driven by the PLATE face crops (face_video) |
| region | regenerates the whole crop | inpaints only the masked hole (background_video + character_mask) |
| lighting | ColorMatch only | relight LoRA + ColorMatch |
| identity | generic head-swap LoRA + identity LoRA | reference image + CLIP-Vision + identity LoRA |

## Measured 2026-09-05 (77 frames, 1080p, this plate)
| | v1 Bernini-R | v2 Animate |
|---|---|---|
| run time | ~56 min | **~5 min** |
| ArcFace vs reference (frontal) | ~0.57 ceiling | **0.70-0.72** (mean 0.68 over the shot, 0.56 at 42 deg yaw) |
| original actor vs reference | - | 0.08 |
| sunglasses | faint / missing | present every frame |
| wardrobe bleed | yes | none (face-only matte, Neck OFF) |

## Run order
1. Block 1b TOTAL FRAMES (77). GUARD must show it.
2. Block 2b: click the face. Run. Check `DBG_crop`, QC hole, QC face driver.
3. Block 6: relight LoRA bypassed until downloaded; identity LoRA 0.7.
4. Deliverables land in `output/vfx_exr/` and `output/vfx/`.

## Downloads that unlock the muted/bypassed parts
- `loras/WanAnimate_relight_lora_fp16.safetensors` (Kijai/WanVideo_comfy, Wan22Animate) -> un-bypass 6c
- `diffusion_models/seedvr2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors` + `vae/seedvr2_ema_vae_fp16.safetensors` (Comfy-Org/SeedVR2) -> block 8 detail pass

## Known limits (not tunable here)
- Plate is 1284x716 AI footage, 172 px face: real pores do not exist in the source. v2 renders the face at ~426 px and can synthesise texture (SeedVR2) but cannot recover what was never filmed.
- ArcFace similarity is unreliable past ~0.65 yaw; judge profiles visually.
- KJ `BatchCropFromMaskAdvanced` local patch and `ComfyUI-HQ-Image-Save` EXR patch are both reverted by pack updates.

nodes.title: ● PER-FACE | 6d | IDENTITY LoRA 0.7 (0.8 = more likeness but the training set's gaze/expression starts to override the plate)
3a | FACE parsing: skin+features+glasses ON, Neck/Hair/Ears OFF
10g | QC hole mp4 (what Animate was asked to paint)
4e | WIDE: face-parse the CROP (skin+features+glasses+hair, Neck OFF)
8m | face-parse the GENERATED crop (skin+features+glasses+ears, Neck OFF)
● PER-SHOT | 2c | what to track (max 32 tokens; ':1' = one object)
● PER-SHOT | 1c | HEAD MODE (regenerate the hair too: hair covers the face, or the hairstyle must change)
2d1 | CLICK the head to replace (run once with 2d2 stop_after_pick ON to see the frame; one click)
● PER-SHOT | 1c' | WIDE SHOT (face under ~200 px at delivery res: matte + driver from the tracked crop)

groups.title: 0 | CONTROL PANEL  -  every value you set for a shot or a face lives here (wireless: Set/Get to the engine)
1 | PLATE  (any length, resampled to delivery res, padded)
3 | MATTE  (face-only: SAM2 head x ClothesSegment Face+Sunglasses)
5 | ANIMATE INPUTS  (background hole, character mask, face driver, reference)
7 | GENERATE  (all chunks, driven by TOTAL FRAMES)
8 | INTEGRATE  (grade to plate) + optional SeedVR2 detail pass
9 | COMPOSITE  (uncrop through the matte, un-pad, build the premultiplied ELEMENT)
